- **Fig 5 text is stale:** the text and caption were written against the earlier Fig 5. They still say German MLP has no bootstrap floor and an open K=3 hyper-parameter marker. The delivered figure now shows all three German MLP retraining floors as "n/a". #5 gives the two sentences to change, in `paper/results.tex` line 72 and the Fig 5 caption.
- **Other captions:** the Fig 4 caption and the new appendix background figure match the figures.
- **Still open:** `figtab-repo`#4 stays open, and so does `experiment-repo`#6, which has the probit fit, the `criterion` column and the other requests. I'm waiting on both and didn't send any other message this turn.
